title: Data Visualization + BI — Civic Metrics Studio
kinesthetic_hook: Run Civic Metrics Studio for ten weeks: clean waits → SQL → stats → charts → KPI story → hashed portfolio dashboard.
lesson_excerpt:
The Civic Metrics Studio in Ghana/Gary partnership hours starts with a dirty CSV of desk tickets: ticket_id, opened_at, closed_at, zone, wait_min. Ticket CM-3102 has 5% null wait_min and two impossible negatives. Cleaning is not optional décor — dashboards that average negatives invent 'negative waits' for the mayor.

You will compute null_rate and drop/impute policy in JSON. Pretty Power BI theme
worked_example: 200 rows, 10 nulls → null_rate=0.05; negatives dropped (not abs).
assignment: Document drop vs impute choice for CM-3102; submit lab_clean_nulls.

weeks.title: SQL joins — tickets to zones without cartesian accidents

lesson.title: SQL joins — tickets to zones without cartesian accidents
lesson.body_md:
Ticket CM-3208 needs a join from tickets to zone_dim on zone_id. A missing ON clause explodes to a cartesian product and invents thousands of waits. You will count joined rows on the fixture and show that unmatched tickets are left out of the inner join used for the median KPI.

tickets=100, zones=5, matching=95 → inner join rows=95. Cartesian would be 500.

weeks.title: Relational modeling — stop repeating zone addresses

lesson.title: Relational modeling — stop repeating zone addresses
lesson.body_md:
Ticket CM-3311 shows zone address repeated on every ticket row. That update anomaly means one rename edit misses 40 rows. You will propose a 3NF-ish split: tickets reference zone_id; zone_dim holds address. The lab checks that repeating groups are removed from the ticket table proposal.

Before: ticket rows carry zone_address text. After: zone_id FK only; address in zone_dim.

weeks.title: Applied stats — median wait beats a vanity mean

lesson.title: Applied stats — median wait beats a vanity mean
lesson.body_md:
Ticket CM-3404 asks for mean, median, and IQR of wait_min on the cleaned fixture. One 120-minute outlier pulls the mean; the median stays honest for the board. You will compute all three. Generative fill of statistics under NO_AI week policy fails.

Sorted waits [...]; median=12; Q1=8; Q3=18; IQR=10; mean inflated by 120 outlier.

weeks.title: Visualization principles — encode waits, don't decorate

lesson.title: Visualization principles — encode waits, don't decorate
lesson.body_md:
Ticket CM-3519 grades a chart spec: mark=bar, x=zone, y=median_wait. A rainbow pie of ticket_ids fails encoding principles. You will validate channel types (nominal x, quantitative y) and refuse 3D extrusion as 'insight.'

Valid: bar + nominal zone + quantitative median_wait. Invalid: pie of unique ticket_ids.

weeks.title: BI workflows — refresh SLA without pirating licenses

lesson.title: BI workflows — refresh SLA without pirating licenses
lesson.body_md:
Industry workflows mention Tableau/Power BI patterns as PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ONLY. Ticket CM-3712 defines a refresh SLA of ≤15 minutes and a license_note that WAIKE does not redistribute vendor binaries. You will encode refresh_minutes and license_ok flags. No cracked installers. No copied sample workbooks from vendor galleries as 'your' work.

refresh_minutes=10 (≤15); license_ok=true with attribution note only.

weeks.title: pandas groupby — zone medians in reproducible scripts

lesson.title: pandas groupby — zone medians in reproducible scripts
lesson.body_md:
Ticket CM-3818 computes median wait by zone with pandas-style groupby on the fixture (plain Python OK if pandas absent). The lab checks the group map and that the script hash is recorded for reproducibility. Notebooks without a pinned input hash fail the portfolio later.

zones A/B/C medians {A:10,B:14,C:12} on fixture; input_sha256 recorded.

weeks.title: Storytelling + KPIs — a formula the board can audit

lesson.title: Storytelling + KPIs — a formula the board can audit
lesson.body_md:
Ticket CM-3909 defines KPI desk_pressure = open_count * median_wait / staff_on_duty. Storytelling means one sentence that states the change, the number, and the action — not a adjective storm. The lab checks the formula evaluation on fixture numbers.

open_count=6, median_wait=12, staff=3 → desk_pressure=24.
